items.title: 66086_Zilner T. Randolph oral history interview
items.q: Bill Eiseley, saxophone, and Slaughter was the drummer one time, and this same lady that was with my band was on piano.

ctx.x: Onstage. Yeah, onstage, (we were in the background) behind the -- the audience could see us, all right, but we'd be behind the performers. And, listen, it wasn't really a big band. [Eisley], saxophone, --
